implement.description: Implement scoped changes — elegant statue, minimal diff

security.description: Security pass — BLOCK or PASS against playbook

verify.description: Run npm test, check:controls, build — no edits

security_pass.prompt: Run security hardening pass per SECURITY_AUDIT.md. Live-prove RLS/authz findings. Fix P0/P1 in scope. Output PASS or BLOCK.

ops_all.prompt: Run full Newdrop ops pass per newdrop-all-pass SKILL.md (security → clone). Do not skip functions.

newdrop_ship.prompt: Ship user-facing What's New path. ≤5s publish proof on dogfood. Update CHANGELOG + run publish-site-changelog if user-visible.

statue_advise.prompt: Advise first per suggestions-first rule unless founder said ship. One job per screen. Remove chrome over adding knobs.

billing_money.prompt: Billing/auth changes: fail-closed, expand-contract migrations, money smoke paths.

product_constraints: Follow elegant statue — fixture not control room
Never commit secrets; AGENT_MEMORY.md same-turn updates for durable truth
Auto-commit/push per AGENT_WORKFLOW unless HOLD_PUSH exists
Verify must pass before declaring cycle complete
